description: Defines the SystemInfo class and related nested classes for managing system subsystem information such as identifier, provisioning, internet, security, location, and time within the Thunder PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class managing system subsystem information and notifications within the Thunder PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Handles system identifier details, including setting and retrieving device ID, architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Provisioning
classes.description: Iterator class for managing provisioning information, including storage details.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Represents internet connectivity info, including IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Security
classes.description: Represents security info, primarily the callsign.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Stores geographic location details such as timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Set
methods.description: Sets subsystem information based on type and provided data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Unset
methods.description: Unsets or disables a subsystem based on type.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Get
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific subsystem.

methods.name: SystemInfo::IsActive
methods.description: Checks if a subsystem is active.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Value
methods.description: Returns the current subsystem flags as a bitmask.

methods.name: SystemInfo::BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Builds a hash representing the system info tree.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the system info.
